title: "1-minute bars for one session"
description: "Closed 1-minute OHLCV bars for one regular session (9:30 to 16:00 ET), oldest first. US stocks and ETFs only. `date` defaults to today in New York. During the session a bar appears about 5 seconds after its minute ends, and the running minute is never included. Poll once a minute at `next_bar_at`: the answer changes once a minute, so polling faster returns nothing new.A past `date` returns the full session and works as a backtest source, within the tier's market-history days (older dates return 402 `UPGRADE_REQUIRED` with `history_days`). Plus and Pro only; Free gets 402 `UPGRADE_REQUIRED` with `feature: 'minute_bars'`.A weekend, holiday or pre-market request returns an empty `bars` array."

Closed 1-minute OHLCV bars for one regular session (9:30 to 16:00 ET), oldest first. US stocks and ETFs only. `date` defaults to today in New York. During the session a bar appears about 5 seconds after its minute ends, and the running minute is never included. Poll once a minute at `next_bar_at`: the answer changes once a minute, so polling faster returns nothing new.A past `date` returns the full session and works as a backtest source, within the tier's market-history days (older dates return 402 `UPGRADE_REQUIRED` with `history_days`). Plus and Pro only; Free gets 402 `UPGRADE_REQUIRED` with `feature: "minute_bars"`.A weekend, holiday or pre-market request returns an empty `bars` array.
